name: Converse Chuck Taylor All Star
summary:
Converse was founded in 1908 as the Converse Rubber Shoe Company, manufacturing rubber soled shoes and boots. Its famous All-Star basketball shoes were introduced in 1918, and improved in 1923 at the request of basketball player Charles H. 'Chuck' Taylor.
